items.text: In ufo, `cleanDoubleSlashes(input, respectQueryAndFragment?)` gained an opt-in `respectQueryAndFragment` flag (decided 2026-11-03), the same name used on the trailing-slash helpers. With `true`, only the part before the first `?` or `#` is cleaned, so `cleanDoubleSlashes("/foo//bar?redirect=//baz", true)` gives `/foo/bar?redirect=//baz`. Default behaviour is unchanged and still collapses `//` in query and fragment, which corrupts redirect targets like `?redirect=//baz`. The implementation is in `src/utils.ts`, documented in `README.md`, and tested in `test/double-slash.test.ts` (query only, fragment only, both, full URL with protocol, `?` after `#`, inputs starting with `?` or `#`, empty input, default/explicit `false`). As of 2026-11-03 the change is uncommitted on branch `fix/double-slashes`; only that test file, `tsc` and eslint were run, not the full suite.

items.text: Tooling and process conventions in ufo: releases use changelogen (adopted Feb 2023) and `chore(release): vX.Y.Z` commits with conventional commit prefixes; renovate[bot] automates dependency bumps (pnpm v9/v10, unbuild, TypeScript, eslint, vitest, codecov v4-v6, GitHub actions such as checkout v6 and setup-node v6) through 2026; autofix-ci automates lint fixes with conventional commit messages (v1.2.0), and automd was added to autofix CI (2024-03-15); tests use vitest (with coverage via @vitest/coverage-c8, vitest v2 in v1.5.4) and linting uses ESLint (v9 by v1.5.4); docs are generated from JSDoc using automd (#209, Feb 2024).

The project relies on Renovate for automated dependency updates (GitHub actions, pnpm v9/v10, vitest, codecov v4/v5/v6, actions/checkout v6, setup-node v6) and autofix-ci for automated lint fixes; releases use `chore(release): vX.Y.Z` commits and conventional commit prefixes. | When: 2023-11 to 2026-04 | Involving: renovate[bot], autofix-ci[bot], Pooya Parsa (maintainer)

items.text: ufo package metadata was revised in Jan 2026 (v1.6.2/v1.6.3): export conditions reordered to prefer esm with a default fallback, and parsePath return type fixed (#293).

ufo's path-joining and base utilities evolved from March 2024: withoutHost was added (#212), joinURL handles ../ segments (#217) and was rewritten (#218), and joinRelativeURL was added (#220) in v1.5.0. Follow-up fixes: base with protocol (#222, v1.5.1), lookbehind regex scoped to joinRelativeURL (#226, v1.5.2), then lookbehind removed for browser compatibility (#228, v1.5.3). Later, v1.6.2/v1.6.3 (Jan 2026) made withBase/withoutBase prevent false prefix matches (#313), and v1.6.4 (2026-04-29) made withoutBase collapse leading slashes (#335).

Releases v1.6.2 and v1.6.3 (Jan 2026): package export conditions reordered to prefer esm with default fallback, `parsePath` return type fixed (#293), and `withBase`/`withoutBase` prevent false prefix matches (#313). v1.6.4 (2026-04-29) fixed `withoutBase` to collapse leading slashes (#335). | When: 2026-01-06 to 2026-04-29 | Involving: Pooya Parsa, daedalus, Florian Heuberger

ufo's URL parsing utilities (hasProtocol, parseURL, parseHost, withProtocol) have been repeatedly hardened for edge cases: Windows file URLs/drive letters (1.0.0, 1.0.1; in v1.5.4 parseURL normalizes drive letters only with the file:// protocol), strict mode/backslash/protocol-relative handling in hasProtocol (v1.1.0), parseHost with/without port (port kept as string), data:/blob: protocols, case-insensitive protocol and script-protocol checks (v1.3.1), and relative protocol in withProtocol (v1.5.4). In April 2025 parseFilename was changed to use optional chaining for opts.strict (#284).

ufo's query utilities (withQuery, getQuery/parseQuery, stringifyQuery) follow conventions refined over time: undefined values removed from withQuery (1.0.0), uniform empty-array handling and QueryValue type fix (1.0.1), values stringified and '[]'/'{}' encoded (v1.1.0), generic types for getQuery/parseQuery with parsed values typed as string only, and stringifyQuery filtering empty values (v1.2.0). In April 2025 (v1.6.0/v1.6.1) a filterQuery utility was added (#287) and parseQuery/query parsing switched to null-prototype objects via Object.create(null) (#286, #290) to avoid prototype pollution and key collisions.

ufo's API grew by small, focused utility functions added per release: isScriptProtocol, parseFilename (v1.2.0), stringifyParsedURL with partial inputs (v1.3.0), withFragment/withoutFragment (v1.4.0, withFragment using encodeHash with early return when no hash change is needed), withoutHost and joinRelativeURL (v1.5.0), and filterQuery (v1.6.0).

April 2025 releases v1.6.0 and v1.6.1: added `filterQuery` utility (#287); `parseQuery` and query parsing now use null-prototype objects (#286, #290 with `Object.create(null)`); `parseFilename` uses optional chaining for `opts.strict` (#284). | When: 2025-04-07 to 2025-04-08 | Involving: Kricsleo, Ezra Ashenafi, Pooya Parsa | Avoid prototype pollution/key collisions in parsed query objects
